items.title: Morgan Stanley Apologizes for Misfired Email
items.summary: Morgan Stanley is trying to figure out how a staffer accidentally leaked an email with highly confidential information. It contained a list of investment-banking deals the firm is working on in Asia. Bloomberg's Sridhar Natarajan reports.

items.title: How Meta's Muse, Vanguard AI Threat Triggered Schwab Sell Signal
items.summary: Charles Schwab stock recovered only modestly on Wednesday morning, a day after leading a wide swath of brokerage, bank and other financial stocks lower as AI-fueled competition heats up.  Rapid adoption of Meta Platforms' Muse personal AI agent and a growing threat from Altruist, an AI platform for financial advisors that was recently acquired by Vanguard, have highlighted two very different type of risks to Schwab's business.

items.title: How Does Meta's Muse AI Raise Risks for Banks & Other Finance Firms?
items.summary: Meta's Muse AI raises risks for finance firms by making it easier for customers to compare rates, fees and products, and move deposits or assets.

items.title: Royal Caribbean Group Falls 5% on $3B Sandals Resorts Stake; Carnival and Norwegian Slide 3%
items.summary: Royal Caribbean just staked billions on a land resort brand, and the market is punishing the stock hard while dragging its cruise rivals down with it. Whether that selloff reflects a smart bet mispriced by panic or a genuine strategic misfire is the question every cruise investor faces this morning.

items.title: Morgan Stanley Investment-Bank Deal List Leaked in Email Misfire
items.summary: A Morgan Stanley staffer accidentally leaked an internal document listing more than 100 investment-banking deals the firm is pitching and monitoring in Asia, revealing details of the bank’s pipeline, according to people familiar with the matter.
